violated_contract: A Dart error that does not terminate an already-started Flutter app must remain reported without being counted as a fatal crash. Boot failures that prevent full startup remain fatal, and native crash reporting is unaffected.
canonical_prevention: Route zone and platform-dispatcher errors through one process-local startup-aware reporting policy, snapshot severity and origin when the handler is invoked, and guard pre-startup, post-startup, and retry behavior with Firebase-free contract tests.
